definitions.short: a plant ; collectively, a plantation ; abstractly, a planting
definitions.full: H5194. neta [ נֶ֫טַע ] noun [masculine] plantation, planting, plant ; — absolute נָ֑טַע Job 14:9 ; construct נְמַע Isa 5:7 ; suffix נִטְעֵךְ 17:11 ; plural construct נִטְעֵי 17:10 ; — 1 plantation Isa 5:7 (figurative of Judab, planted by ׳י ); 17:10 (figurative of idolatry), so 2 act of planting Isa 17:11 . 3 plant Job 14:9 (in simile).
